say: this is the animatic skill. hand your agent a video script, and you get back a draft of the video before you film anything.
it cuts the script into beats. each beat gets the line that's said, and a still of what the viewer should see.
before it spends anything, it tells you what the run will cost, and checks your balance.
then deepgram tts narrates every beat, and it all lands in one mp4. this video is one.
it's on github. point it at your script, and watch your video before you shoot it.
